home.title: Prepare your trip at sea with greater confidence.
home.subtitle: FishSafe turns weather and marine forecasts into a simple risk level before and during your trip.
home.beforeDepartureDescription: Area, duration, vessel, wind, waves and swell are assessed before departure.
home.atSeaDescription: The risk level is recalculated as time passes and conditions evolve.
home.offlineDescription: Useful forecasts are stored on the phone before departure.
home.notice: FishSafe is a preventive decision-support tool. It does not replace official bulletins, maritime authorities or safety rules at sea.

prepareTrip.title: Prepare my trip
prepareTrip.subtitle: Location, duration and vessel. FishSafe handles the rest.
prepareTrip.locationHelp: GPS is used to retrieve conditions for your area.
prepareTrip.durationHelp: How long do you expect to stay at sea?
prepareTrip.missingMessage: Choose a location, duration and vessel type.
prepareTrip.analysisErrorMessage: FishSafe could not retrieve the forecast. Check your Internet connection and try again.
prepareTrip.locationPermissionError: Location permission is required to use GPS.
prepareTrip.locationUnavailableError: Unable to retrieve your location. Make sure GPS is enabled and try again.

conditions.offlineSaved: These forecasts are already stored on the phone for offline use.

activeTrip.demoText: Advance the forecast hour by hour to demonstrate how FishSafe reassesses risk as conditions change.
activeTrip.riskAlertMessage: Forecast conditions are deteriorating. In the final version, the recommendation will be defined by your validated risk model.
